name: draft-polish-read
description: Iteratively improve a product announcement until a rubric passes.

stages.prompt: Do not use tools. Write a short launch announcement for the product named in the workflow input `product` (a note-taking app with an offline mode and a free tier). Round 1: write freely, enthusiastic. Later rounds: fix every failure the reviewer listed in the carry-forward context, keep what already passed. Put the announcement text in <analysis>; <control>{"schema":"stage-control-v1","digest":"draft"}</control>.

Do not use tools. Review the draft against this rubric, counting carefully word by word: R1 at most `maxWords` words (workflow input); R2 contains the exact phrase "offline mode"; R3 contains the exact phrase "free tier"; R4 the last sentence starts with "Try"; R5 no exclamation marks. Put in <control>: {"schema":"stage-control-v1","digest":"<n> failures","passed":true|false,"blockingFailures":<integer count of failed rules>,"wordCount":<integer>,"failures":["R1: 52 words, limit 45"]}. passed is true only if blockingFailures is 0. In <analysis> quote the draft and give specific fixes.

Read the final round's draft with workflow_artifact (source draft-loop.draft, artifact analysis) and copy that announcement text verbatim into <analysis>, nothing added. Control: {"schema":"stage-control-v1","digest":"final","rounds":<integer rounds used, from the Loop Results block>,"passed":<boolean from the Loop Results block>}.
